# Support

- **Have a question or need help using GenCore?** Please open a
  [Discussion](../../discussions) in the Q&A category rather than an Issue.
- **Found a bug?** Open a [bug report issue](../../issues/new/choose).
- **Have a feature idea?** Open a [feature request issue](../../issues/new/choose).
- **Found a security vulnerability?** Do not open a public issue or
  discussion — follow the private disclosure process in `SECURITY.md`.

Issues are reserved for actionable bugs and feature requests so maintainers
can triage them efficiently; general questions and open-ended discussion
belong in Discussions.
